tests.description: Validation-only command that exits successfully.
Validation-only command that exits with failure.
Validation-only command that proves required diagnostics block PASS when capture is unavailable.
Validates the V002 one-file application structure, inline JavaScript, embedded CSS, required architecture markers, and absence of runtime sidecar dependencies.
Validates the M1 cache architecture and normalized Blueprint/Recipe Slot/Ingredient model fixtures.
Validates global Quality batch inventory rules, deterministic slot allocation, card priority, shortages, real blueprints, and a larger performance fixture.

Validates dynamic mining categories, nullable signature, exact per-commodity quality, deterministic location ranking and merging, dynamic station/module/gadget loadouts, missing equipment preservation, sync boundaries, and a 5000-location performance fixture.

Validates Combined Materials as an Allocation Engine projection, slot-level Quality detail, deterministic card priority, backup schema/migration/preview/roundtrip/rollback, diagnostic markers, and a 1000-card performance fixture.

Validates UEX refinery normalization, exact and versioned VERIFIED_CANONICAL_ALIAS Wiki mapping without fuzzy matching, value_month per-system ranking, ties, zero/negative values, TTL/limit/rollback boundaries, shared Crafting/Combined snapshots, diagnostics, and a 500-row performance fixture.

Validates the complete standalone Crafting/Farm Card snapshot and reference UI, per-card exports, slot-level allocation/Quality, mining/refinery/loadout embedding, offline resource independence, escaped content, metadata, JSON roundtrip, and a 120-slot export fixture after M1-M5.

Runs M1-M6, then validates all 8 enabled V1 navigation targets, Material Database search/category/detail reuse, existing Mining Loadout UI/User Data wiring, UI audit markers, and responsive layout. Real click/reload/console proof is captured separately in Chrome.

Runs M1-M6.1, validates the single embedded application CSS source, simulates file:// and HTTP without CSS network/CSSOM access, copies the HTML alone into an empty directory, removes remote font dependencies, and validates standalone export CSS readiness.
V002 release-development gate: full M1-M6.1 and C04 regression plus embedded CSS integrity and zero local runtime sidecar dependency.
Stable V002 gate: full regression, exactly one runtime HTML, checksum, live Wiki/UEX APIs, manual Chrome evidence, and unchanged V001.

V003-dev gate: full M1-M6.1 and C04 regression, live Wiki commodity/location/resource proof, primary-resource filtering, deterministic spawn/occurrence/quantized-Quality ranking, and frozen V002 integrity.

V003-C002 gate: full M1-M6.1 and C04 regression, live Aluminum/Agricium/Stileron grouping proof, provider/resource/parent-gated presentation groups, unchanged C001 ranking/secondary exclusion, shared standalone export rendering, and frozen V002 integrity.

V003-C003 gate: full M1-M6.1/C04/C001/C002 regression, live 206-record Wiki commodity audit, centralized deterministic display names, alias/raw search, proven duplicate projection, standalone export naming, and frozen V002 integrity.

V003-C004 gate: curated Radar Signature registry with Wiki API_RAW diagnostics, Top-3 dense rank tiers per system/environment, SCMDB read-only comparison audit, shared UI/export projection, full C001-C003/M1-M6.1/C04 regression, and frozen V002 integrity.

V003-C005 gate: exact Lagrange F primary/secondary decision trace, full Radar reconciliation, unchanged C004 Top-3 projection, legacy cache and shared consumer checks, C006-C010 roadmap lock, full C001-C004/M1-M6.1/C04 regression, standalone export, and frozen V002 integrity.

V003-C006 gate: final Crafting Card view-model, cache/API material hydration, output item presentation, quantity/max-craftable and offline states, complete JS-300 standalone projection, full C001-C005/M1-M6.1/C04 regression, and frozen V002 integrity.

V003-C007 gate: canonical Radar Signature image pixel/SHA audit, exact Wiki UUID material color registry, neutral UNMAPPED_COLOR fallback, shared Crafting/My Materials/Combined/Material Database/export resolver, complete C001-C006 plus M1-M6.1/C04 regression, standalone export, and frozen V002 integrity.

V003-C008 gate: same-file detail controller/router, five snapshot-backed detail types, separate public Wiki/API actions, invalid/old-cache/offline cases, standalone interactive detail, complete C001-C007 plus M1-M6.1/C04 regression, and frozen V002 integrity.

V003-C008.1 gate: exact public MediaWiki title/redirect proof, separate public Wiki and API resolvers/actions, snapshot-backed standalone parity, no blind public URL generation, complete C001-C008 plus M1-M6.1/C04 regression, and frozen V002 integrity.
